messages:
Riley Park: Quick sync  vendors pushed slightly different validation windows. we need a one-line decision: stagger NA/EU vs global hold for joint press.
Hannah Cho: Short: stagger NA/EU listing, gate APAC until vendors confirm fixes. minimizes customer risk.
nvidia_anna: NVIDIA: H200 microcode patch planned 2026-06-10; partner validation ~1 week. can provide embargoed perf on 06-07.
amd_suzanne: AMD: MI300 driver 5.3.3 ETA 2026-06-22, partner validation ~3 biz days. we'll send test plan 06-18.
Riley Park: Proposed micro-plan: 1) integrator preview (invite-only) 2026-06-12-06-14, 2) NA/EU marketplace "Preview" listing 2026-06-20, 3) APAC listing post-validation (aim early July), 4) full joint press after all validations.
Hannah Cho: Support asks: UI flag "Preview - limited capacity" + short tooltip; simple runbook for fallback (default H200->H100).
nvidia_anna: we'll drop an embargoed compatibility matrix 06-05. please confirm integrator list for preview.
amd_suzanne: will do. vendor will share partner lab results once 5.3.3 is out.
legal-bot: Reminder: any region gating or modified availability copy requires legal sign-off prior to public listing. attach approvals to the release pipeline.
Riley Park: OK action owners: Hannah -> marketplace copy + support Q&A, Ops -> fallback routing policy, Vendors -> embargoed matrices & artifacts, Riley -> calendar invites + press cadence.
release-bot: Pipeline note: `marketplace-preview` scheduled 2026-06-20 16:00 UTC (pending legal & artifacts).
Hannah Cho: I'll draft the listing text and a 3-question support FAQ by 2026-06-08.
Riley Park: Thanks all  tagging vendors: @nvidia_anna @amd_suzanne pls post embargoed artifacts on schedule. :thumbsup:
